title: RuView — Now and Last Night
description: The home right now and over the last day: room state, room-level heart and breathing rates when published, people estimate, person slots, the server's own states, last night's summary and the newest events.

target.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       concat_ws(' ', tags ->> 'kind', tags ->> 'label', tags ->> 'action', tags ->> 'person')
         || coalesce(': ' || (fields ->> 'text'), '') AS text,
       concat_ws(',', tags ->> 'kind', tags ->> 'source') AS tags
FROM ingest.annotation
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time,
       (tags ->> 'entity') || ' on ' || substring(tags ->> 'device' FROM 'node[0-9]+$')
         || coalesce(', confidence ' || round((fields ->> 'confidence')::numeric, 2), '') AS text,
       tags ->> 'entity' AS tags
FROM ingest.ha_event
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

list.name: tz
list.label: Home time zone
list.description: Days and nights are counted in this time zone (the home's).

panels.title: Room now
panels.description: From the newest state row of the last 2 minutes: empty, still, moving or active; CSI offline while the server only re-sends its last frame.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN stale_source = 1 THEN 'CSI offline'
            WHEN presence = 0 THEN 'empty'
            ELSE motion_level END AS "now"
FROM ingest.state
WHERE time > now() - interval '2 minutes'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: People (estimate)
panels.description: The server's estimate of how many people the CSI sees (newest live row). Person tracking is not reliable yet: treat it as a hint.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT n_persons AS "people"
FROM ingest.state
WHERE time > now() - interval '2 minutes' AND stale_source = 0
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Heart rate
panels.description: Median of the heart rates published in the last minute (live rows only). Room-level CSI estimate, published only with exactly one person in the room and a fresh empty-room calibration; not a medical measurement.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY heart_rate_bpm) AS "heart rate"
FROM ingest.state
WHERE time > now() - interval '1 minute' AND stale_source = 0

panels.title: Breathing rate
panels.description: Median of the breathing rates published in the last minute, under the same rules as the heart rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY breathing_rate_bpm) AS "breathing rate"
FROM ingest.state
WHERE time > now() - interval '1 minute' AND stale_source = 0

panels.title: Vitals
panels.description: Whether the server publishes vitals now, and if not, why (newest row of the last 2 minutes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN stale_source = 1 THEN 'CSI offline'
            WHEN numeric_vitals_authorized = 1 THEN 'published'
            ELSE coalesce(abstention_reason, 'none given') END AS "vitals"
FROM ingest.state
WHERE time > now() - interval '2 minutes'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Calibration
panels.description: Whether an empty-room calibration is fresh enough for vitals (newest row), and its age from the watchdog's automatic calibration.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.calibration_fresh AS "fresh",
       (SELECT (fields ->> 'calibration_age_h')::float
        FROM ingest.watchdog
        WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND fields ? 'calibration_age_h'
        ORDER BY time DESC
        LIMIT 1) AS "age"
FROM ingest.state AS s
WHERE s.time > now() - interval '2 minutes'
ORDER BY s.time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Room
panels.description: The most common state of each bucket: empty, still, moving or active, and CSI offline where no row had a live source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval),
       CASE WHEN sum(n_live) = 0 THEN 'CSI offline'
            WHEN sum(n_active) > 0 AND sum(n_active) >= greatest(sum(n_absent), sum(n_still), sum(n_moving)) THEN 'active'
            WHEN sum(n_moving) > 0 AND sum(n_moving) >= greatest(sum(n_absent), sum(n_still)) THEN 'present_moving'
            WHEN sum(n_still) > 0 AND sum(n_still) >= sum(n_absent) THEN 'present_still'
            ELSE 'absent' END AS "room"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heart rate (room level)
panels.description: Median heart rate per bucket from published values of live rows. Gaps mean the rate was withheld (Data Health shows why). Room-level CSI estimate, not a medical measurement.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval, NULL),
       sum(hr_med * hr_n) / nullif(sum(hr_n), 0) AS "heart rate"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Breathing rate (room level)
panels.description: Median breathing rate per bucket, as for the heart rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval, NULL),
       sum(br_med * br_n) / nullif(sum(br_n), 0) AS "breathing rate"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: People (estimate)
panels.description: The server's people estimate per bucket: average and highest. Two people in the room withholds vitals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval, NULL),
       sum(n_persons_avg * n_live) / nullif(sum(n_live), 0) AS "average",
       max(n_persons_max) AS "highest"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Motion energy
panels.description: Median motion energy per bucket (live rows).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval, NULL),
       avg(motion_energy_med) AS "motion energy"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND n_live > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Person slots
panels.description: Zone of each person slot of the mqtt-bridge (ruview/person), the last one seen in each bucket. Slots follow tracks, not identities: slot 1 is whoever the server tracked first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
       'slot ' || person_key AS slot,
       coalesce(last(zone, time) FILTER (WHERE occupied = 1), 'not seen') AS zone
FROM ingest.person
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Server states per node
panels.description: The sensing server's own states per node (built-in publisher, the same as the Home Assistant entities): presence, someone sleeping, room active and possible distress. Node 1 is in the bedroom, node 2 at the study desk, node 3 beside the living-room sofa.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
       substring(device FROM 'node[0-9]+$') || ' ' || replace(entity, '_', ' ') AS metric,
       max("on") AS value
FROM ingest.ha_binary
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND entity IN ('presence', 'someone_sleeping', 'room_active', 'possible_distress')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Asleep (server)
panels.description: Hours the sensing server's someone_sleeping state was on, on the node that reported most of it. Not checked against a reference device yet (WP2.2). Last night is 21:00 to 09:00 in the home's time zone; before 09:00 it is the night in progress.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
    SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') - interval '3 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz' AS t0,
           least(now(), (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS t1
)
           , s AS (
               SELECT device, "on",
                      least(lead(time) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY time), w.t1) - time AS dt
               FROM ingest.ha_binary, w
               WHERE entity = 'someone_sleeping' AND time >= w.t0 AND time < w.t1
           )
           SELECT max(h) AS "asleep"
           FROM (SELECT device, extract(epoch FROM sum(least(dt, interval '5 minutes'))
                                               FILTER (WHERE "on" = 1)) / 3600 AS h
                 FROM s GROUP BY device) AS d

panels.title: Heart rate
panels.description: Median of the heart rates published last night (live rows). Last night is 21:00 to 09:00 in the home's time zone; before 09:00 it is the night in progress.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
    SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') - interval '3 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz' AS t0,
           least(now(), (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS t1
)
           SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY heart_rate_bpm) AS "heart rate"
           FROM ingest.state, w
           WHERE time >= w.t0 AND time < w.t1 AND stale_source = 0

panels.title: Breathing rate
panels.description: Median of the breathing rates published last night (live rows). Last night is 21:00 to 09:00 in the home's time zone; before 09:00 it is the night in progress.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
    SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') - interval '3 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz' AS t0,
           least(now(), (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS t1
)
           SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY breathing_rate_bpm) AS "breathing rate"
           FROM ingest.state, w
           WHERE time >= w.t0 AND time < w.t1 AND stale_source = 0

panels.title: Vitals published
panels.description: Share of last night's live rows with someone present that carried a heart rate. Two people in the bedroom withholds every value. Last night is 21:00 to 09:00 in the home's time zone; before 09:00 it is the night in progress.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
    SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') - interval '3 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz' AS t0,
           least(now(), (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS t1
)
           SELECT count(heart_rate_bpm)::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE presence = 1), 0) AS "published"
           FROM ingest.state, w
           WHERE time >= w.t0 AND time < w.t1 AND stale_source = 0

panels.title: People (estimate)
panels.description: Median of the per-minute people estimate last night. Last night is 21:00 to 09:00 in the home's time zone; before 09:00 it is the night in progress.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
    SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') - interval '3 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz' AS t0,
           least(now(), (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS t1
)
           SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n_persons_avg) AS "people"
           FROM agg.state_1m, w
           WHERE bucket >= w.t0 AND bucket < w.t1 AND n_live > 0

panels.title: Bed exits
panels.description: bed_exit events from the sensing server last night. Last night is 21:00 to 09:00 in the home's time zone; before 09:00 it is the night in progress.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
    SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') - interval '3 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz' AS t0,
           least(now(), (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz') + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS t1
)
           SELECT count(*) AS "bed exits"
           FROM ingest.ha_event, w
           WHERE time >= w.t0 AND time < w.t1 AND tags ->> 'entity' = 'bed_exit'

panels.title: Events, labels and kept clips
panels.description: Newest first: the sensing server's events (fall, bed exit, room transitions), the label buttons and automatic calibrations, and the raw CSI clips the recorder kept.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, kind, what, "where", detail
FROM (
    SELECT time, 'event' AS kind, tags ->> 'entity' AS what,
           substring(tags ->> 'device' FROM 'node[0-9]+$') AS "where",
           coalesce('confidence ' || round((fields ->> 'confidence')::numeric, 2), '') AS detail
    FROM ingest.ha_event
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time, 'label', concat_ws(' ', tags ->> 'kind', tags ->> 'label', tags ->> 'action'),
           coalesce(tags ->> 'person', tags ->> 'source'), coalesce(fields ->> 'text', '')
    FROM ingest.annotation
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time, 'kept clip', tags ->> 'tag', tags ->> 'source',
           concat_ws(', ', tags ->> 'status', (fields ->> 'duration_s') || ' s')
    FROM ingest.recorder_keep
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
) AS e
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 200
